description: ADJ-LADDER rung 28 — coagulation ratios from a single clotting screen (a NEW panel: coagulation / hemostasis). From three stated times (prothrombin time PT, activated partial thromboplastin time APTT, normal PT control CONTROL) compute the PT ratio (PT/CONTROL), the PT fractional prolongation ((PT-CONTROL)/CONTROL), or the PT:aPTT ratio (PT/APTT). Each item is a compute_dimensioned program (observe the three times, let answer = formula); the ADJ engine carries the arithmetic — mixing DIVISION with a SUBTRACTION-IN-THE-NUMERATOR fraction on a fresh organ system — and the harness matches the scalar to the printed options. Contamination-safe: every index is built only from the three observed quantities via - and / — no constant leaks — and the observed quantities carry digit-free identifiers so no numeral hides inside a variable name. The five options are a family over the same quantities, so the distractors are exactly the slips students make: the inverted PT:aPTT ratio (aPTT/PT) and the absolute prolongation in seconds (PT-CONTROL, forgetting to divide by the control). The core confusion tested is the ratio vs the fractional prolongation — PT/CONTROL versus (PT-CONTROL)/CONTROL, which differ by exactly 1.

items.stem: A coagulation panel shows a prothrombin time of 18 s, an activated partial thromboplastin time of 40 s, and a normal PT control of 12 s. What is the patient's PT ratio?
items.program:
observe prothrombin_time(18)
observe partial_thromboplastin_time(40)
observe control_time(12)
let answer = prothrombin_time / control_time
? answer

items.stem: A coagulation panel shows a prothrombin time of 18 s, an activated partial thromboplastin time of 40 s, and a normal PT control of 12 s. What is the patient's PT fractional prolongation?
items.program:
observe prothrombin_time(18)
observe partial_thromboplastin_time(40)
observe control_time(12)
let answer = (prothrombin_time - control_time) / control_time
? answer

items.stem: A coagulation panel shows a prothrombin time of 18 s, an activated partial thromboplastin time of 40 s, and a normal PT control of 12 s. What is the patient's PT-to-aPTT ratio?
items.program:
observe prothrombin_time(18)
observe partial_thromboplastin_time(40)
observe control_time(12)
let answer = prothrombin_time / partial_thromboplastin_time
? answer
